'''Gabbro's Island''' is an island on [[Giant's Deep]] where [[Gabbro]] resides and has set up their camp.

== Details ==

=== Features ===
'''Gabbro's Island''' is one of the islands that floats on Giant's Deep, recognizable from the campfire smoke trailing above it. A nearby cave contains a small amount of [[Ghost Matter]], with Gabbro lounging under the small island mountain in a hammock. 

Gabbro's camp is located slightly higher on the island; the path being around the back side of the mountain from the island shore. The camp has oxygen, fuel refill, and a campfire. The island, like others, can be thrown into the atmosphere if a cyclone passes overhead (though Gabbro will not be too concerned).
== Rumors ==
* Gabbro is lounging in a hammock near the island's shore.
* Gabbro found a Nomai statue on another island. The statue's eyes started glowing and Gabbro saw their memories flash before their eyes.
* Gabbro remembers dying starting on the second cycle during game play. They saw their memories flash before their eyes, just like the time with the statue.
* Gabbro and the player seem to be the only ones aware that they are in a time loop.
